t: Durable, lightweight waterproof dealer boots with a crazy horse leather upper. Features slip-on design with pull tabs and twin elastic gussets. Oil-resistant sole to improve traction on slippery surfaces, and an energy-absorbing heel puts less pressure on feet and joints. Steel impact and compression-resistant toe cap protects toes and feet from potential hazards when working in high-risk environments. Steel penetration-resistant midsole offers protection against sharp objects. Padded tongue and collar, with cushioned sole, for maximum comfort.
b: Not Tested for Sole Heat Resistance
